scripts.clean: docker system prune -f && docker volume prune -f
scripts.restart:dev: npm run stop:all && npm run start:dev
scripts.reset: npm run stop:all && npm run clean && npm run start:dev
scripts.start:dev: npm run network && cross-env ENV=dev npm run infra:up && cross-env ENV=dev npm run svc:up && cross-env ENV=dev npm run app:up && npm run info:dev && echo 'DEV STARTED'
scripts.start:prod: npm run network && cross-env ENV=prod npm run infra:up && cross-env ENV=prod npm run svc:up && cross-env ENV=prod npm run app:up && echo 'PROD STARTED'
scripts.infra:edge: cross-env ENV=prod node ops/scripts/ctrl.js up infra:edge
scripts.mobile:sync: trapeze run apps/client/trapeze.yaml --project apps/client --var PACKAGE_VERSION=${npm_package_version} --var BUILD_NUMBER=$(git rev-list --count HEAD)
scripts.mobile:build:android: trapeze run apps/client/trapeze.yaml --project apps/client --var PACKAGE_VERSION=${npm_package_version} --var BUILD_NUMBER=$(git rev-list --count HEAD) --platform android
scripts.mobile:build:ios: trapeze run apps/client/trapeze.yaml --project apps/client --var PACKAGE_VERSION=${npm_package_version} --var BUILD_NUMBER=$(git rev-list --count HEAD) --platform ios
scripts.mobile:build:all: trapeze run apps/client/trapeze.yaml --project apps/client --var PACKAGE_VERSION=${npm_package_version} --var BUILD_NUMBER=$(git rev-list --count HEAD) --platform android --platform ios
scripts.mobile:build:clean: trapeze run apps/client/trapeze.yaml --project apps/client --var PACKAGE_VERSION=${npm_package_version} --var BUILD_NUMBER=$(git rev-list --count HEAD) --platform android --platform ios --clean
scripts.mobile:build:clean:android: trapeze run apps/client/trapeze.yaml --project apps/client --var PACKAGE_VERSION=${npm_package_version} --var BUILD_NUMBER=$(git rev-list --count HEAD) --platform android --clean
scripts.mobile:build:clean:ios: trapeze run apps/client/trapeze.yaml --project apps/client --var PACKAGE_VERSION=${npm_package_version} --var BUILD_NUMBER=$(git rev-list --count HEAD) --platform ios --clean
scripts.mobile:build:clean:all: trapeze run apps/client/trapeze.yaml --project apps/client --var PACKAGE_VERSION=${npm_package_version} --var BUILD_NUMBER=$(git rev-list --count HEAD) --platform android --platform ios --clean
